note: Starting points for the look board, not defaults: the app shows three at a time, none pre-selected. Palette order is background, text, accent, accent 2. Every id must exist in the skill (backgrounds.js, fonts-free.json, the Packs table); tools/check.py and the tests verify it.

packages.name: Clean signal
packages.why: Clear and reassuring: a calm dark base, one warm accent, crisp wipes.

packages.name: Loud and fast
packages.why: Beat-driven and punchy: heavy condensed type, hard contrast, big hits.

packages.name: Slow film
packages.why: Dramatic and unhurried: deep dark, soft light, long holds.

packages.name: Quiet precision
packages.why: Calm and exact, with room for dry humour: paper tones, one red accent.

packages.name: Toy box
packages.why: Bouncy and colourful: warm paper, bright accents, round friendly type.

packages.name: Decode
packages.why: Digital and quick: near-black green, terminal accents, a grid behind.
